screen.reason: This is a randomized clinical trial evaluating the clinical efficacy of an ML-based interactive rehabilitation system compared to conventional therapy in stroke patients with aphasia. It evaluates the tool's effectiveness rather than testing a specific implementation guardrail or deployment practice.
